lyrics:
[Intro: banjo riff, foot stomps, whistled tune]

[Verse 1: playful female voice, rhythmic]
You slid up to my table with a grin and a line
Asking what I'm drinking, asking for my time
Honey, I've been playing since before you could count
You want what I'm holding? Well, let's find out

[Chorus: stomps, claps, group shouts]
Got any hearts? (Go fish!)
Got any diamonds? (Go fish!)
Got any reason I should let you sit?
Honey, I ain't mean, I'm just holding what I got
You can ask all night, I'm gonna tell you what
(Go fish!)

[Verse 2: playful, band fuller]
Last one tried to bluff me with a borrowed truck
One before that thought he'd try his luck
I got a full hand, baby, got my friends, got a band
Got a dance floor waiting and a drink in my hand

[Chorus: stomps, claps, group shouts]
Got any hearts? (Go fish!)
Got any diamonds? (Go fish!)
Got any reason I should let you sit?
Honey, I ain't mean, I'm just holding what I got
You can ask all night, I'm gonna tell you what
(Go fish!)

[Dance Break: whistle melody, banjo, called steps]
Stomp it out, two, three
Spin it round, two, three
Hands up if you came with nobody
And you're leaving just as free

[Bridge: beat drops, close voice]
Now if you want to pull a chair up and just talk
No game, no line, no clock
I might have a card for you

[Final Chorus: whole room, loudest]
Got any manners? (Maybe!)
Got any patience? (Maybe!)
Got any reason I should let you sit?
Honey, I ain't mean, I'm just holding what I got
You asked real nice, so I'll tell you what
(Okay. One dance.)

[Outro: banjo riff, whistle, stomps stop]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 110 BPM, 4/4, D major. A bright, bouncing stomp, half barn dance and half club.

VOICE: Female, agile and teasing, sliding between singing and rhythmic speech, with stacked harmonies. A mixed group shouts the answers. The bridge is close and nearly whispered.

INSTRUMENTS: Plucked banjo riff, foot stomps and handclaps instead of a drum kit for most of the song, a whistled melody, upright bass, viola or fiddle drones, acoustic guitar, a deep kick only in the choruses.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, banjo, stomps, whistle. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:32 Chorus 1. 0:56 Verse 2. 1:18 Chorus 2. 1:42 Dance break, whistle and called steps. 2:02 Bridge, beat out. 2:18 Final chorus with the changed answers. 2:44 Outro, ends on a stomp at 2:56.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2024 country-pop: acoustic and percussive, very little reverb, the crowd close, the low end modern.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The answer changing to '(Okay. One dance.)' at 2:40.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original invites everyone to the floor. This one is a woman in no hurry, on a full night out of her own, who can be won only by someone who stops performing.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Amused, unimpressed, dancing, relenting a little.
